_note: CI replays recorded model responses inside the production image, so a run is deterministic and needs no noise allowance: the thresholds equal the current dev scores (extraction macro 0.9958, worst field 0.95, decision 0.95, citation recall 0.975 and all-cited 0.925, precision 1.0). One flipped claim is 2.5 points, so any drop is a real change. If a deliberate improvement or re-recording moves the scores, update this file in the same pull request and say why.
